abstract: One hundred and fifteen cases of testicular tumors treated at our Hospital between 1970 and 1989 were analyzed. The incidence of testicular tumors was 0.44% in the male outpatient department of our urological clinic. The age of these patients ranged from 6 months to 86 years (average: 31.7 years old) with two peaks in distribution; 0 to 5 and 21 to 45 years. Most of their chief complaints (77%) were painless swelling of scrotal contents. Location of the tumors included 56 in the right, 57 in the left and 2 on both sides. Histologically, there were 68 cases of seminoma, 10 cases each of embryonal carcinoma and teratoma, 22 cases of mixed type, 3 cases of malignant lymphoma and 2 cases of others. Stage of tumor was stage I in 69 cases, IIA in 25 cases, IIB in 8 cases and III in 13 cases. High orchiectomy was performed on all the patients. Radiotherapy, chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection were respectively done in 77, 42 and 16 cases. Seventeen patients died, and the 5-year survival rate calculated by the Kaplan-Meier method was 87.9% in seminoma and 68.9% in non-seminoma. The survival rate for the patients treated by chemotherapy including CDDP after 1983 was compared to those treated by other therapy before 1982. Between the two groups there was no significant difference.
abstract_ja: 1970年から1989年の間に当院で治療した精巣腫瘍115例を解析した。泌尿器科外来の男性患者における精巣腫瘍の発生率は0.44%であった。患者の年齢は生後6か月から86歳まで(平均31.7歳)で、0～5歳と21～45歳の2つのピークがみられた。主訴の多く(77%)は陰嚢内容の無痛性腫脹であった。腫瘍の部位は右56例、左57例、両側2例であった。組織学的には、セミノーマ68例、胎児性癌および奇形腫がそれぞれ10例、混合型22例、悪性リンパ腫3例、その他2例であった。腫瘍の病期は、病期I 69例、病期IIA 25例、病期IIB 8例、病期III 13例であった。全例で高位精巣摘除術を施行した。放射線療法、化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清は、それぞれ77例、42例、16例に施行された。17例が死亡し、Kaplan-Meier法で算出した5年生存率は、セミノーマで87.9%、非セミノーマで68.9%であった。1983年以降にCDDPを含む化学療法で治療した患者の生存率を、1982年以前に他の治療で治療した患者と比較したが、両群間に有意差はなかった。
